blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial Government sees no immediate need to declare a dengue outbreak, saying existing interventions and hospital preparations are in place to address the rising number of infections. The province has activated dengue fast lanes in all provincial hospitals and coordinated with local government units (LGUs) on mosquito-control measures, officials said. Cebu Province recorded 7,816 dengue cases and 40 deaths from Jan. 4 to Nov. 14, 2026, the highest among the provinces and highly urbanized cities in Central Visayas.
